# opencode-console-notify 4.0.1 — doctor fix on macOS

## Fixed

- **Go doctor now recognizes `osascript` as the notifier backend on macOS (darwin)**: `checkNotifier` previously fell through to "notifications not supported on darwin", so `doctor` exited 1 and the `macos-latest` CI job failed. Added `case darwin -> osascript` so the Go doctor verifies the macOS end state (plugin + `osascript`) and exits 0 when healthy.

This is a pure CI/test fix: no behavior change on Windows or Linux. The npm package `opencode-console-notify@4.0.1` and all Go CLI binaries (Windows, Linux, macOS amd64/arm64) include this fix.

Full notes: https://github.com/IbatoLionDev/opencode-console-notify/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md#401---2026-10-18
